tools.description: Generate invoices for completed projects, manage customer records, and track payment status.

actions.description: Look up an existing Stripe customer by email, or create a new customer record if one does not exist.

parameters.memo: string — invoice memo with late fee policy and project reference
parameters.auto_finalize: boolean — false (finalize after delivery email is sent)

returns.invoice_url: string — Stripe hosted invoice URL for client payment
returns.invoice_pdf: string — URL to download invoice PDF

tools.description: Send the client delivery email with download links, invoice, and delivery manifest.

parameters.body_html: string — HTML-formatted email body with delivery details, Drive link, invoice summary, and EEVL branding

tools.description: Create the client-facing shared delivery folder, copy final deliverables, and manage project archival.

actions.description: Create the client delivery shared folder with appropriate structure.

parameters.parent_folder: string — EEVL Productions base folder ID
parameters.name: string — 'EEVL_Delivery_{ClientName}_{ProjectCode}_{Date}'

parameters.new_name: string — client-friendly file name (no internal codes)

actions.description: Share the delivery folder with the client and set access permissions.

actions.description: Move the project folder to the archive location after delivery.

tools.description: Complete all project tasks, log final metrics, and move the project to the Completed Projects space.

custom_fields.delivery_link: string — Google Drive shared folder URL
custom_fields.total_project_days: integer — days from brief to delivery
custom_fields.revision_rounds: integer — number of revision rounds used
custom_fields.invoice_amount_cents: integer — total invoice amount in cents

actions.description: Add a completion comment to the Final Delivery task with summary details.
